residual_convention: residual = y_true - y_pred; positive residual = UNDERPREDICTION; negative residual = OVERPREDICTION
attention_interpretation: temporal token allocation, NOT raw-feature importance, NOT causal attribution
error_cohort_interpretation: HIGH_ERROR / LOW_ERROR are Test-relative diagnostic cohorts, NOT deployment regimes, NOT used for retuning
cross_seed_head_cue: Same numeric head indices across seeds were NOT assumed semantically equivalent; Phase 57 used canonical JSD matching within each layer
